notes: Two versions in one update. THE THREAD MAP (v0.47): a new panel draws your linked cards as a picture. Columns are depth, so a card sits to the right of everything that has to happen before it - the further right something is, the more is stacked in front of it. A solid arrow means blocks, a dotted one means derives from, and a diamond-tipped line means part of. The layout is worked out fresh from your links every time and never stored, so it cannot go stale, and it deliberately does not drift: the same card lands in the same place every visit, which is what makes it worth learning. Click any card to light up just its neighbourhood and dim the rest; if it belongs to something bigger, that family is ringed. You can narrow to one thread or one track, and the panel only appears once a board actually has links. FOLD AND REARRANGE THE BOARD (v0.48): the page is five panels and nobody reads them in the same order, so now you decide. Click any section heading to fold it down to a single bar, and drag that heading to move the whole panel up or down the page. The panel you are carrying lifts, and a blue line shows exactly where it will land. Stasys remembers your arrangement and opens the way you left it - remembered for you, in your browser, not written into the project, so it never fights with anyone else or shows up as a change to your files. A Reset button appears once you have moved something, and only then.
